summary: Endeavour Silver filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 production release dated October 8, 2026. The company reported 2,096,545 silver oz and 10,126 gold oz, or 3.6 million silver-equivalent oz, with year-to-date output of 5,915,874 silver oz and 32,340 gold oz (10.4 million AgEq oz). Terronera was suspended August 12–24 due to a blockade, and Guanacev's mill was taken offline September 21 for head and trunnion repairs. Kolpa throughput rose to 256,052 tonnes. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is involved; operational disclosure only.
